name: nekudot
description: Add 'nekudot' or diacritics to Hebrew text.

scripts.copy: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -R images dist/images && node scripts/quantize_model.mjs model dist/model && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp node_modules/@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-wasm/dist/*.wasm dist/wasm/
scripts.build: parcel build content.js background.js --no-source-maps --dist-dir dist && npm run copy
scripts.build-dev: NODE_ENV=development parcel build content.js background.js --dist-dir dist && npm run copy

author: Gilad Amar
